description: This file defines an abstract base class 'NumericFieldRendererBase' for rendering numeric fields within the MigraDoc RTF rendering subsystem. It includes logic to translate numeric formats (e.g., ROMAN, alphabetic) into RTF syntax and logs errors for unknown formats.

classes.name: NumericFieldRendererBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for rendering numeric fields in RTF, providing format translation and error logging functionalities.

methods.name: TranslateFormat
methods.description: Translates the numeric field's format property into corresponding RTF control words, handling specific formats and logging errors for unknown values.
